VI.description: Saves ONE project library file in place - the .lvlib itself\2C not its members - in the application instance of the project that is ACTIVE in the IDE.\0A\0AWHY IT EXISTS. Delacor's Rename Event.vi renames an event's VI and typedefs with Save As and deletes the old files\2C and the library in memory follows the new names\3B but it saves only the project\2C never the library. Measured 2026-10-06\3A after a headless rename the .lvlib on disk still listed the three deleted files while LabVIEW's copy listed the new ones\2C and neither Parse Project for DQMH Modules.vi's Any Dirty Modules? nor a modified-VI scan reports a library-level change. Delacor's dialog leaves the same state to a later Save All by a person.\0A\0AChain\3A Project\3AActive Project -> Application -> Library.Open on library path -> Library Save to the same path -> Close Reference on the library and on the project reference.\0A\0ARequires a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE. Generated by LabVIEWMCP.
